name: Clean Windows and user temp files (Windows)
description: Removes files older than N days from C:\Windows\Temp and each profile Temp folder, reports bytes freed. Does not touch SoftwareDistribution. Dry run by default.

params.name: age_days
params.label: Minimum age in days
params.description: Only files last modified more than this many days ago are removed (1 to 365).

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When enabled, nothing is changed and the script only prints what it would do.

output: Per-location [DRY-RUN]/[DONE]/[SKIP] lines and a total of bytes freed. Exit 0; exit 2 on a bad parameter.
